thread:
alice: Pager: canary traffic spike + tokenization errors after rollout. Seeing lots of garbled outputs and 500s. Can someone pick up?
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered: INC-1337 — canary model variant 2024-05-18-v3 promoted to staging. Error rate > 8% on /generate.
sam_oncall: I'm on it, looking at canary logs now. What was promoted? artifact tag `weights:v20240518`?
alice: Correct, promotion happened as part of the automated release pipeline at 16:12 UTC. We got a small thumbs-up from the release job.
maria: I'm seeing tokenizer mismatch warnings in the canary hosts: "vocab_lookup failed" and "unknown token prefixes" in the logs. Example: `TokenizerError: unknown id 65536`
ben_sre: Can confirm latency spike + decoding errors. Tentative hypothesis: weightset compiled against older tokenizer spec, config mismatch in `model-config.json` (vocab_hash mismatch).
linh_prodeng: If tokenizer and weights are out of sync, generated tokens will be nonsense. We should kill canary traffic and fallback to previous variant ASAP.
opsbot: Executing abort command on routing layer: `redwood route update --canary-id canary-2024-05-18 --scale 0`
opsbot: Result: OK — canary routes drained to 0 within 30s.
sam_oncall: Throttled canary, but customer-facing errors already observed for ~2 minutes. Any active customers? running top5 customer queries now.
alice: Customer Impact: a handful of low-volume API keys surfaced with anomalous outputs. No mass outage, but degraded correctness for ~120 requests. Logging CVs to audit.
maria: Start rollback promotion to previous stable weightset `weights:v20240430` and force tokenizer config to `tokenizer:v2`.
ben_sre: Rolling back via deploy pipeline: `redwood deploy promote --target staging --artifact weights:v20240430 --tokenizer tokenizer:v2`
ben_sre: Deploy job started; CI job reports artifact checksum mismatch earlier, adding check now.
linh_prodeng: Also toggle feature flag kill-switch for auto-promote to prevent another auto-promotion: `feature_flag:disable auto_weight_promote`
opsbot: Feature flag updated: `auto_weight_promote` -> disabled (user: linh_prodeng).
sam_oncall: After rollback completes, please sweep caches — KV cache may have cached tokenization prefixes from the bad model. Command: `redis-cli EVAL cache:invalidate_token_prefixes 0`
alice: Good call. Ben, confirm rollback success and post the cutover time for incident timeline.
ben_sre: Rollback finished at 16:18 UTC, staging serving `weights:v20240430` + `tokenizer:v2`. Error rate back to baseline in ~90s.
maria: Running regression eval on sample prompt set — outputs look sane now. No further 500s.
sam_oncall: Marking incident as contained. I'll open an oncall-handoff and follow with postmortem. Notes: root cause = automated promotion of weights compiled against mismatched tokenizer/config; missing checksum/vocab_hash validation in promotion job.
alice: Please page release engineering for emergency postmortem and add rollout guard: verify tokenizer hash in artifact metadata before promote.
linh_prodeng: Will schedule immediate postmortem and a quick hotfix pipeline to add the check. Also adding an alert rule to detect tokenizer mismatch signatures earlier.
sam_oncall: Handoff to oncall rotation for follow-up: @maria for verification, @ben_sre for rollback docs, @linh_prodeng for pipeline fix. Closing pager. :white_check_mark:
